prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. TOP LEFT — Easter (n.复活节): A simple decorated Easter egg in a basket beside a small spring flower and a plain wooden cross, respectful holiday cue.
TOP RIGHT — fascinate (v.迷住，吸引住): A visitor gazes transfixed at a luminous unusual sculpture, wide attentive eyes, body leaning slightly toward it.
BOTTOM LEFT — affectionate (a.充满深情的，柔情的): An adult gently hugs a beloved cat against their chest, warm tender expression and the cat relaxed.

review_notes: Reviewed Easter symbols, absorbed visitor, affectionate cat hug and puzzled viewer of unexplained glowing box. Proper senses, natural anatomy and white cell margins checked.
